title: Two-tape table reader is a prefix inverse
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, every transition table on states $0,\ldots,n$ and the three possible scanned symbols (blank, $0$, $1$) on the input tape and on each of two work tapes, and every bit string $x$, the table reader applied to the serialization of that table followed by $x$ succeeds and returns the table and $x$. The table serialization lists the action for each state and each triple of scanned symbols; each action records the input-head movement, the optional write and movement on each work tape, the optional output bit, and the optional successor state.
hypotheses_covered: A two-work-tape transition table on Fin (n+1) states and the three scanned-symbol options for the input and each work tape
